initialization: same-seed F32 final nonlinear host, exact initial predictions; zero residual outputs; all parameters trainable; Adam reset to zero
primary_gate: Per seed: tactical cutoff-aware lower point gain >=0.05, approximate family-adjusted paired-cluster bootstrap lower bound >0, no detected regression among three local opponents, final cutoff rates <=0.05. Overall learning requires all three seeds.
external_assessment: Foul Play is never trained on. Three paired contrasts share the 12-cell approximate multiplicity family. Report transfer descriptively, retain all seeds/cutoff bounds; no public-strength certificate.
sampling: Complete games and GAE before deterministic row selection; equal params within a cohort; fresh episode cursors per stream; no outcome-dependent game replacement.

verification.scope: Sampled verification; external search randomness is not reproduced.

interpretation: Representation, further training, Adam reset and opponent mixture change together. This screen tests a candidate package, not an isolated architectural effect. Development panels use fresh games and recurring official generation.
failure_policy: Preserve every attempted game and failure. Stop the fixed execution; no automatic retry, seed replacement, dropped cells, budget extension, or promotion.
